title: GHG (greenhouse gas) emissions measurement
description: Runtime grams CO2e measurement attached to an order fulfillment. Runtime-attested: content is a free-form uint256 grams value, not cross-checked against the agreement. Pairs with the figaro-ghg disclosure clause (which commits the accounting methodology + scope) when the standard of accounting needs to be fixed at contract time.

fields.name: grams
fields.description: Grams CO2e measured for this fulfillment. Decimal string (bigint-parseable). No upper bound enforced on-chain — callers responsible for unit sanity.
